sense.text:
Today’s lesson is Enter the Dragons: the various levels of Satan. Write it down: dragons, plural; the devil; devils, plural; serpent, singular; and Satan, singular. The word demon is not in the Bible, though we often use it when we speak. And evil angels: write that down too.

“The great dragon was cast out, that old serpent”: that old serpent meaning from Genesis, “called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.”

Many people, especially Christians, read that on just one level. But it is twofold: this scripture about the devil, Satan, the old serpent that deceiveth the world speaks of angels, spirits and people. Write that down: angels, spirits and people.

precepts.why: “That he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is”. The secrets of wisdom are often double. So Revelation 12:9 is not one level the way Christians read it: it is a twofold scripture, speaking of angels, spirits and people.

sense.text:
An example of spiritual wickedness. “We wrestle not against flesh and blood”: this isn’t a physical fight that we’re in. We’re fighting “against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

There are levels to Ephesians 6:12. Most Christians read it and can’t explain it; they just go, Satan, and that’s it.

precepts.why:
“He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.” A lot of Christians don’t understand that there are evil angels, and God has ordained them.

That last angel that came on Egypt we know was the death angel, and that was Christ. It was evil to the Egyptians, not to us.

Well, what about Satan? “I saw the Lord sitting on his throne”: you got to imagine what’s being written. “And all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.”

“And the Lord said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead?” The Lord asks all the angels of heaven a question. “And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner”: one angel stood up and said this, another stood up and said that. This is a council going on in heaven. Some of you brothers don’t like councils, but there are councils in heaven. White men understand that, but some black people don’t understand there’s a necessity for counsel to be had.

“And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will persuade him.” The Lord asked him, “Wherewith?”, how are you going to persuade him? “I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.” The Lord sanctioned his angel to go forth and be a lying spirit. Christianity ain’t going to teach you that.

This is how the Lord does things. Some of y’all with the Christian mindset are going to be confused by these scriptures: no, not my God, not Jesus. “For this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”. How does God send strong delusion? We just read an example in the book of Kings.

That’s Christianity: they all have a lying spirit on them. That’s why Christians can’t see that Christ is a man of color, a black man. They will read it and go, no, because there’s a lying spirit on them: some of your mothers, some of your fathers, sisters and brothers.

sense.text: An example of how the spiritual realm operates. “Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.” This verse kills the stupid Christian doctrine that God and Satan had a fight and God kicked Satan out of heaven. No: all the evil angels are in order with God. He created them, and they do his bidding just like the righteous angels.

“And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.” The Lord is having a conversation with Satan. Is this an angel that was kicked out of heaven? Read the first three chapters of Job: the Lord is talking to Satan and there’s no problem. Hey, what’s going on, Satan, what you doing, what’s today’s agenda? Just what I’m doing. So, ‘consider my servant Job’.
“Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.” The devil.

On fasting: there are two reasons you could fast. One is to draw closer to the Lord; the other is for health reasons. If you’re fasting for health reasons, that’s fine, but don’t assume that person is doing it because they love the Lord.

“Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.” Write that down. Don’t let a Christian tell you to only use the New Testament: every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God is the entire Bible. And by this time, was the New Testament even written yet? No. Christians don’t know the scriptures at all.
“If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee”. Satan knows the scriptures too: he was quoting Psalms 91.
“It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.” Christ came back and cut him with Deuteronomy 6: no, because in Deuteronomy 6 it says such and such.
“And sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them”. Notice it says all the kingdoms of the world: all the kingdoms through time. He showed Christ everything.

“All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.” I’ll give you rulership of all of this; just worship me.

A lot of times men and women want to be blessed, want to be certain millionaires, and you got to do certain things. You might say, I have never worshiped the devil. If you’ve got a white jesus on your wall or a cross on your neck, you’re a liar: you have worshiped the devil. If you’re in the midst of committing adultery, your pornography; some women become millionaires doing OnlyFans: you have worshiped the devil, and now you are a millionaire. Congratulations.
“Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve. Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.”
“A beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.” This is explained later on in the class.

“Like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: this is talking about nations on earth.

“And the dragon gave him his power”: the dragon here is Satan. This beast with seven heads and ten horns is the EU, the European Union; more detail later in the class.

You think the dragon gave him his power for free? That’s Matthew 4: he told Christ, if you worship me I’ll give you all the kingdoms of the earth. Now the EU has come along, Esau. They have worshiped Satan, and Satan has given them seemingly unlimited power on this earth: “his power, and his seat, and great authority.”

This shows how the Bible uses dragons, Satan and devil in different, various ways. “And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon”: write this down, for the dragon put politics. The first frog is politics, and that’s an unclean spirit. “And out of the mouth of the beast”: put economics, finances. “And out of the mouth of the false prophet”: put Christianity. What you are to see is how the unclean spirits rule through nations.

Out of the mouth of the beast, economics: the IMF, the International Monetary Fund, and the World Bank. Esau controls that. They’re the ones that dictate that Africa’s money is garbage. All the gold and the diamonds are over there, but they say, you might be wealthy in that context, but to us your money is garbage; we’re going to take your gold and your diamonds. Thus saith the IMF and the World Bank. That’s an unclean spirit.

And the last, out of the false prophet: that’s Christianity.
“And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness, Being forty days tempted of the devil.” This is the same thing we read in Matthew 4.
“There met him two possessed with devils”. It says devils, plural. This is not the devil; this is devils.

“What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?” There’s a time sanctioned when these devils, plural, that are inside of people will be bound.

“Your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”: just what we read in Job chapter 1, going to and fro in the earth. It says the devil there, not devils, but the devil. There is a hierarchy in the heavens and upon the earth.

“When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man”: remember Matthew 8, they had unclean spirits in them. Notice it’s singular, the unclean spirit. With all those things read in Mark 7:21, which are in all of us, men and women, there may be one major one that you struggle with, or maybe two; only you and the Lord know. That’s you: you repent, brother or sister.

“He walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.” It comes out of you and the spirit is walking through the congregation, through the internet, through the people watching: let me try and come to this person here.

“I will return into my house from whence I came out”: I can’t get in these people, let me go back to where I came out from. “And when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.” When the spirit comes back to you, whether it’s adultery, the spirit of theft, the spirit of lasciviousness, an evil eye, hate towards your brother or your sister, the spirit says this house is empty, swept and garnished. It’s like an open house, when you go to buy a house or look at an apartment: empty, like nobody ever lived there. But you’re not supposed to be looking like an open house. He’s looking around: Christ, the Son of God, the Holy Spirit, ain’t here.

“Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself”: I got plenty of room in this Negro, this Latino; let me get seven other spirits more wicked than me. “And they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.” You might have only been battling with the spirit of theft, but now you got seven more demons, worse. What the hell is going on with me? Matter of fact, you probably won’t even notice it, because you ain’t got the Holy Spirit; you think it’s normal. Now you’re opening up an OnlyFans page.

“Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.” Christ said this is how this generation is, and this generation today has seven, eight demons in them. That’s why you see sin all the way.

precepts.why:
You may ask yourself, what is the unclean spirit? “For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders, Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.” An evil eye is hate towards your brother. We have all those things within us; that’s what the Bible says.

Thefts: some brothers or sisters are kleptomaniacs. Remember the sister at one of our events that stole an iPhone, and her husband tried to lie about it; she didn’t know there was a camera above videotaping the whole thing. Some people are kleptos, and they might be in here with us; that don’t mean everybody. With some it might be adultery: you like dealing with married people. Fornication, lasciviousness: all of it deals with sexual sins, and some battle with that.

“Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.” Christ is supposed to be in your spirit, in your brain, in your soul. The spirit of Christ, the Holy Spirit, is supposed to be within you. So when the unclean spirit comes back and finds the house empty, swept and garnished, it is because Christ, the Holy Spirit, ain’t there.

sense.text: “And took the ashes of the perfumes, and put the heart and the liver of the fish thereupon, and made a smoke therewith.” No, this is not voodoo; this is how the Lord wanted it to go down.

“The which smell when the evil spirit had smelled”: see that, the evil spirit, singular. “He fled into the utmost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him”: meaning he could not leave the area of Egypt; that spirit was bound there.

You can see that today: certain cities have certain spirits bound in those areas. Chicago, what kind of spirit is bound there? Murder. San Francisco, Oklahoma: each has its spirit bound there. This is how the Bible uses the terminology for Satan.
“Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field”. That goes back to what we read in Revelation 12:9: ‘that old serpent, called the Devil’.

Now we’re going to talk about friends. The friends topic was only going to be for the brothers, but because of such illustrious emails from the sisters, you have to be included. Sisters, if you want to get up and walk out, bye bye, have a good time.

“I am a brother to dragons”. Remember, Job had three friends that were supposed to be counseling him, and they kept giving him bad counsel. So he calls men on earth dragons. “And a companion to owls.”

precepts.why: “In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil”. Satan, the devil, has children on this earth. “Whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God”: if you don’t believe on Christ, keeping the commandments, you’re not of God. Then he stresses “neither he that loveth not his brother”, which is your neighbor. Those are the children of the devil.

sense.text: These are generic scriptures, gone through again to show how the Lord uses the terminology of Satan, the devil, spirits and angels. “If thou wouldest get a friend, prove him first”: men and women, if you want to get a friend, you got to prove that friend. “And be not hasty to credit him”: don’t be quick to credit him.

“For some man is a friend for his own occasion”. Sisters, you better peep that: some brothers got game. “And will not abide in the day of thy trouble.” That goes for you brothers too: you think the brother next to you is your friend? Don’t be telling people what you got. Like one brother who came up and told a sister, I make x amount of money. Why you tell her that? Now you never know if she is really with you for you, or because of what you make. Brothers are the same way.
“There is a friend, who being turned to enmity and strife will discover thy reproach”: turned to hatred and strife, he’ll tell all your business.

“Again, some friend is a companion at the table”. That’s why, sister, the people on Facebook making plates of food showing how good they cook: he’s only talking to you because he knows you cook good. “And will not continue in the day of thy affliction”: when you’re going through hard times, he’s out the door.

“But in thy prosperity he will be as thyself, and will be bold over thy servants.” He’s telling your kids, shut up, sit down, go over there; telling your friends, don’t do that; like that’s his house.
“If thou be brought low”: you lose your job, “he will be against thee, and will hide himself from thy face.”
“Separate thyself from thine enemies, and take heed of thy friends.”

precepts.why: “Commend not a man for his beauty”. That’s what women do: they commend a man for his beauty. Oh look at him, his shoulders are so wide, he got size 14 shoes, daddy got hazel eyes. “Neither abhor a man for his outward appearance”: look at him, short, fat and black; look at him, skinny, buck teeth, one eye crooked; look at this … That’s when they look at the outward appearance. Brothers do that too, but this is talking about women.

sense.text:
Infidelity is an evil spirit. A woman who passes another man’s child off on her husband is spoken of right here: “Thus shall it go also with the wife that leaveth her husband, and bringeth in an heir by another.” This is shown so you know it is not just getting on a woman. God said it.

That is why brothers need to get a paternity test, and if the woman gets mad about a paternity test, she’s a hoe. Don’t trust it, and don’t let them guilt you. The brother who raised a girl for eleven years and found out she was never his, and was still ordered to pay, is what happens when you don’t. Lasciviousness and adultery fall under that evil spirit we read about.

The Bible lays out her sin three ways: “first, she hath disobeyed the law of the most High; and secondly, she hath trespassed against her own husband”, and thirdly she hath played the … in adultery, “and brought children by another man.”

The Bible talks about that. That is why sisters don’t want us to talk about this: so don’t talk about my evil.

God knew how women would be in the last days, and this is why he gave men a commandment: “thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people”. He didn’t tell us to be quiet and not speak about them. He said set your face against them. Y’all get mad if you want; this is just what the Bible says.

The daughters he speaks of are those “which prophesy out of their own heart”: they come from their own opinion, what they think and how they feel. So God says you men better stand up and speak against them: “and prophesy thou against them”. All you simps out there who disagree, you disagree with God, with what the Bible just said.

So you read that and say, God, is this woman bashing? Are y’all crazy, are you insane? There’s demons on these women that say that. We can get on a man all day and it’s good, but the second you go on the woman’s side, it’s what the hell’s wrong with you, you got the devil in you.

The Lord commands us to set our face against the sisters because the sisters are our biggest fight, always fighting against us, always trying to stop us, always got something to say. They are the first enemy we have to fight: deal with them and put them in order, then go deal with the heathens. That’s the order.

You can be in your Christian mentality and try to ignore all these scriptures all you want. ‘I would have left them alone,’ but we got some wicked sisters among us. Don’t leave them alone.

“Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.” These evil communications open a door for Satan, for unclean spirits.

The old heads know Millie Jackson. Her records were played every Sunday, and the children would hear it and laugh, sent to the next room like they couldn’t hear through the wall. The parties with the velvet posters of women with big afros and skimpy clothes, the purple lights and the doors made of beads. Moms Mabley was ratchet, telling you about sex: that is how children learned about it. Listening to that will open up demons to you, because the things they talk about no child should be listening to. Nobody should be listening to that stuff.

Bring it up to today, for the millennials: Lil Kim was one of the first that was ratchet; now it is Cardi B and Megan, the stallion, and a stallion is a male, so she’s making herself a horse, a mare. Listening to that is very ratchet and it opens up doorways. When you read stuff like the video vixen called Superhead, or watch those videos, unclean spirits enter in. They used our people to open these doors, and they got paid very well to push it out into the black and Latino community.

That ratchetness is why some brothers are going across the seas to get a wife, the passport bros. Brothers can’t take the Western-minded, feminist, ‘I do bad all by myself’ woman. Brothers say they are looking for a wife; sisters say they don’t want to get married, they don’t believe in marriage. So some brothers go across the seas. Why are you mad if a man goes across the seas to get a wife? He ain’t no damn good now, he’s dusty, because he wants to avoid ratchetness. One sister wrote that we promote whoremongering. There has never been a class telling brothers to go to Santo Domingo, have sex and come back. That is deflection.

“In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin”: there wanteth not, meaning it lacketh not. There is an abundance of sin in many words. When somebody likes to take a conversation over and is just constantly talking, sin is in that conversation. When people write you letters and the letters are mad long, they are sinning there. This was read before reading the sisters’ emails: scroll down and see how long it is. That’s all emotions.

One letter said it was not a complaint but an observation from a woman of color, that the Clubhouse topics were bashing black women again, that it was not a safe place. So all the black women on stage in Clubhouse were asked, have I attacked you? Every one of them said no. You always get one like this that needs to be heard with her emotions. That’s a damn lie: men get ripped to shreds in that Clubhouse and are terrified to come on stage. Show me on Clubhouse where y’all are getting wisdom like this from the Bible and true life experiences.

The minute a woman accuses us of being abusive, what they always use is the tone: it’s not what you said, it’s how you said it, you’re too aggressive. Sister, what did I say wrong? They never can substantiate their claim. The same sisters complain in one room and speak against us in another, and change their profile picture to do it. We’re not stupid.

She said men are not chastised for their lustfulness but praised for making children all over the USA. That’s a damn lie: those men are ridiculed for not taking care of their children. She said Latinas are never spoken about. When black people are spoken of here, you are included. Latin women, you don’t get no pass.

“And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.” Offended in me means whatever this Bible says, we should not be offended at. We are coming out of the Bible. Don’t be offended, and you’re blessed. But if you are offended, this truth is not for you. Go back to T.D. Jakes, go back to Creflo Dollar, Jamal Bryant, Juanita Bynum, and listen to those lies: this is your season. That’s what you want to hear.

The Bible is an offensive book. Christ himself said offensive things to the disciples that were following him, and sometimes offensive things are said to get rid of the brothers and sisters among us that don’t believe. It is like taking a broom.

A sister wrote that a woman came to the school with zeal and left after a rant about women’s weight. There are plenty of big beautiful women in Israel United in Christ, and some are big for medical reasons, a thyroid problem. We’re not talking about those, but about the ones that choose to stay that way and won’t make any attempt, the same way we get on the men. We are at war, the devil is trying to take your soul, and as things escalate you have to be in good shape. Brothers and sisters have been passing from high blood pressure and other diseases; there have been many funerals these last months. So the people are told to eat healthy, work out and take care of themselves.

When we get on the brothers, they fix it. Men hold each other accountable: the brother told his stomach is big goes home and goes to the gym. Try to tell a woman her stomach is big and it’s World War Three. They don’t care about no scriptures. We know the Bible, we know things are going to get bad, and it would be evil for us to stay quiet and not address it. The Bible says you got to love yourself; you can’t be home overeating, you hate yourself. Many sisters have sent before and after pictures, formed workout groups and held each other accountable. Don’t let these chicken McNugget sisters take you in a different direction. You are gotten on because something good is seen in you that can change.

The same letter said she would not lose weight because she knows how wicked she was when she was in shape and had a nice body. That’s why she won’t lose weight. She wrote the letter as if on behalf of somebody else, but she was telling about herself. Sis, just get the medicine and heal from that.

“I had rather dwell with a lion and a dragon, than to keep house with a wicked woman.” See that, brothers: some of you are living with a dragon. The dragon is in the house. It is easier to live with a lion or a dragon than to keep house with a wicked woman. Move over lion, move over dragon, I’m sitting next to you rather than be with a wicked woman.

The rebellious women are given an opportunity to voice their opinion, and the sister in the video saying ‘stop policing women’ has the opinion of some of the women in IUIC. Notice what she added: she said the man left her barefoot and pregnant, and that was nowhere in the writing. That is what some of these women do to justify their bull: they add extra things to confuse the conversation. This is the sister’s mindset that God said to set your face against, and sisters that come in with that same mentality, we have to speak against you.

“I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts.” See that: after their own thoughts. That is what our people base everything on, their own thoughts. That is why the sister in the video said ‘this is my opinion’, and her opinion is television, the feminist movement. It is not what God says.

This is the mindset of some of the sisters we have to deal with, the Millennials, and God said to set your face against them. Sisters who come in with that same mentality, we have to speak against you. This is not a safe place if you are going against God: keep your mouth shut, get your notebook out and learn.

Our job is to bring all men and women back to what the Most High says, and it is not going to be easy. It is going to be tussling, arguing, fighting against people who fight the word of God. That is why in the New Testament Paul says for you woman to shut the hell up, because you were disrupting the word of God from going out. When the word of God is coming out, be in silence, because you will have people who interject with no biblical understanding and destroy everything God is trying to build.

The woman in the clip made the argument that the father was never around, never came to her school, never paid child support. If he did not pay child support there are only a few reasons for it, and the main one is that the sister does not know who the baby daddy is. If she knew who the baby daddy is, she would take the child support immediately, like the average woman does. So why did she not go after him for any of it?

But we do not advocate men not taking care of their kids. “But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.” That is what we teach, that is what we preach, that is what we apply. We advocate for that thing right there.

And some sisters have decided they do not want to be subject to their husband. They have ridiculed him, called him names, given his children to other people and taken pictures of them to mock their husband. We have seen it all.

There is no such thing in the Bible as biracial; you are what your father is. The man in the clip calls himself biracial, and he is angry. Who is he mad at? His father. That is the whole root of his anger. Some of what he said about black men being supposed to build their families is correct; that is what we teach and what the Bible teaches. But the rest of it is wrong.

“And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath.” Don’t provoke your children to wrath, meaning God’s wrath, by not teaching them and not guiding them in the way they should go. “But bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.” The father is to be present. That is what the Bible teaches.

A sister sent that clip from another Israelite sister, one who likes to teach while her husband sits there quiet, whispering scriptures, and the wife does all the teaching. She used it to say all black men, first and foremost, are dusty. The devil is a liar.

Some sisters pull this verse and ask a question about it. “And the devil shall smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more.” This is talking about Tobias, who was going to marry this sister. She had a devil around her, and the Lord showed Raphael the angel what to do to get the devil out.

“But when thou shalt come to her, rise up both of you, and pray to God which is merciful, who will have pity on you, and save you: fear not, for she is appointed unto thee from the beginning.” See that part right there: she is appointed unto thee from the beginning. “And thou shalt preserve her, and she shall go with thee. Moreover I suppose that she shall bear thee children. Now when Tobias had heard these things, he loved her, and his heart was effectually joined to her.”

Sisters use this verse and Genesis 24 to ask, was I appointed for this man? Here is the answer: both men were virgins and both women were virgins.

God has appointed a woman for every man, but the woman has missed the opportunity by whoring herself out, just as the man has whored himself. Today it has become an insult to be a virgin, when it was admired in the Bible. People bring up Samson, but Samson was a whoremonger, and look what happened to him; we are not to follow that example.

Brothers who are virgins, honor that thing. Not any old scallywag; that will destroy your life. Let them know you are high value men, make sure she is a virgin, get a virgin: you have royal seed inside of you. And sisters who are virgins, you are in a safe place here. Honor that.

precepts.why:
Abraham sent a servant to get a wife for his son Isaac. The servant stood by the well: “Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water.” He asked for a sign: “let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac.”

That is what the class was to see: “let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.” The same word as Tobit, appointed.

So when sisters use Tobit 6:17 and Genesis 24 to ask whether they were appointed for a man, the answer is that both of those men were virgins and both of those women were virgins. That is the kind of union God appointed.

sense.text:
The men were questioning Christ about marriage, and Christ’s answer matches exactly what the bishop said: both were virgins. That is why Christ had to tell them they erred, not knowing the scriptures.

“For this cause shall a man leave father and mother.” Why do you leave your father and mother? Because they raised you and nurtured you in the Lord. A believing father and mother are not going to let their son be a whoremonger, banging a whole bunch of sisters. This is according to the guidelines of an Israelite, coming from a believing mother and father.

“And shall cleave to his wife.” How does that happen? He is betrothed, he is promised. There is a courtship, and there are people involved. You are raising your son for an Israelite daughter who is not a hoe.

“And they twain shall be one flesh.” His mother and father and her mother and father know that for this union to work, for them to be one flesh, they have to instill the laws of God inside of them.

“Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh.” There is a way things are organized according to the scriptures so that this one flesh union works.

“What therefore God hath joined together.” Who joined them together? God. God don’t join hoes together; he don’t join whoremongers together. A lot of people’s relationships were not according to the guidelines of God, and they are mad, and now that we are trying to straighten them out with the word of God they are mad too.

This is how you know what God joined together. Right now you are divorced: you left over some argument. When God joins a marriage together, that brother and that sister are going to work things out. A person that fears God, in a marriage God brought together, no matter what they go through, will fix the problem and endure, because they understand that they are heirs together. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” So it’s talking about Edom. Rase it, rase it means destroy it, destroy it; that’s what they did to us. “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”: the daughter of Babylon, that’s Edom. King David prophesied the destruction of Edom in Babylon. That ain’t hate speech; we’re prophesying the love of God.

Where the Lord said everything that you did to my people you did to me. “For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.” Watch this: “In all their affliction he was afflicted”. In all our affliction the Lord was afflicted; our churches ain’t going to teach you that. “And the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.” So that’s going to happen again. What America has done to us, the Lord felt all of that.

This matches what was said: when you touch us, the Most High catches feelings behind that. “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon”: that’s us; right now we’re being delivered with the scriptures. “After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you”: they spoiled us in slavery. “For he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye”: you people that put your hands on us, we are the apple of God’s eye.

“For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.” Right now they just think we’re some … reading the Bible; they’re going to realize we were sent by God. Exactly.

sense.text:
“Though Babylon should mount up to heaven”: that’s the same thing we read in Obadiah, exalting yourself as the eagle and setting your nest among the stars. “Yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the Lord”: we read that in Revelation 17, where he said I’m going to bring them ten horns and they’re going to turn against you. No matter how powerful you think you are, what I said is going to come to pass.

“And though she should fortify the height of her strength”: that’s going into their space, the space force. That’s what they’re fortifying their strength with. The Lord said he ain’t worried about that, and Israel, don’t worry about that either: I got this.
“Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice”: the great voice is that media of theirs; it’s going to be destroyed.

precepts.why: “And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues. For her sins have reached unto heaven”: Babylon mounting up to heaven, her sins reaching unto heaven. “And God hath remembered her iniquities.”

sense.text:
“And he laid hold on the dragon”: pay close attention. “That old serpent”: remember Genesis, that old serpent. “Which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years”.

The first thought, which is a correct thought: that’s Satan and those unclean spirits, all that, they’re going to be bound. That is correct. But it’s also going into a double meaning behind it: it’s about the white man too.

“And cast him into the bottomless pit”: that’s what we just read in Isaiah 24 about the prisoners. Those prisoners are nations, Edomite nations. “And shut him up, and set a seal upon him”: that seal is going to say not to be released. You don’t go past this borderline of the Caucasus mountains; y’all stay over there.

“That he should deceive the nations no more”: some of y’all thought it was just a spiritual demon. The spiritual demon got children on the earth doing his bidding, deceiving everybody. “Till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season”: after that he’s going to be loosed.

precepts.why: The precept: nobody escapes, nobody gets away. “And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit”: that’s them Caucasus mountains. “And shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited”: after many days, a thousand years.

He must be loosed a little season. “And after many days shall they be visited”: that’s a thousand years; we’re going to pay them a visit. “Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion”: he’s going to reign.

Read from verse 21: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones”: that’s the so-called white man, America and their allies. “That are on high”: that’s literally the ruling nations, and them that are in space. “And the kings of the earth upon the earth”. Then they are gathered as prisoners in the pit and shut up in the prison, and after many days visited. Jump to verse 23: “Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed”, meaning their moon and their sun, “when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.” It doesn’t really go into detail there, so we have to go back to Revelation 20, where he gives the details.

sense.text: “Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection”: that’s all of us in here and all of us listening; we all want part of the first resurrection when Christ returns. “On such the second death hath no power”: the second death is when the Father returns. “But they shall be priests of God and of Christ”: that’s what we’re going to be. “And shall reign with him a thousand years.”
“And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison”.

“And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.” This is going to be after the thousand years. Christians use Gog and Magog to talk about now; that’s not talking about now, this is after the thousand-year reign.

Some Israelite camps (we ain’t going to call no names) say we reigned with Christ a thousand years during the Dark Ages. That’s incorrect. During the Dark Ages we were worshipping idols, we hated each other, we were killing each other. That’s not a thousand years reigning with Christ.

Satan goes out to deceive the nations: the spiritual demon gets let loose, and where does he go? To Esau, his children. He goes to his kids.

“And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about”: that’s what we just read in Ezekiel 38. “And the beloved city”: that’s Jerusalem. “And fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.”

precepts.why: “Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog”: this is the area of Russia, that area from Russia along towards the Caucasus mountains. That whole area over there is where … is going to be pushed up to; that’s the pit. “Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army”. Watch this: “Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them”. So Esau is going to gather these nations: “Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.”

“Thou shalt think an evil thought”: these nations led by Gog and Magog are going to think an evil thought. “I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates”. Is Israel over there dwelling safely? No, they’re always fighting with the Palestinians. He’s telling you this Israel is dwelling safely.

“To take a spoil”: take a spoil means to rob; they’re going to come to rob true Israel, us. “And to take a prey”: who do y’all think the prey is? They want to take us: let’s make them slaves again. “To turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited”: Israel over there today is desolate. We’ve been there; it is desolate. They fly grass over there, they fly trees over there to give the illusion like it’s prosperous.

“And upon the people that are gathered out of the nations”: that’s us, being gathered out of all the nations. “Which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land”: our economy is going to be the top economy. That’s the camp of the saints they compass about in Revelation 20.

“And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord God: every man’s sword shall be against his brother. And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.” Y’all see that: fire and brimstone. It’s the same thing we just read in Revelation 20, the fire that came down from God out of heaven and devoured them. “Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the Lord.”
